2026-10-24.meal: Slow-cooker creamy chicken, leek & mushroom casserole
2026-10-24.note: This week's one meat night. Francis at the nerd convention, Jess & Mathilda seeing cousins today, so slow cooker on before you head out and tea's ready whenever everyone's back

ingredients: 1 tbsp cornflour, mixed with a splash of water
150ml crème fraîche (or oat crème fraîche / oat cream for dairy-free)
Mash or crusty bread, to serve
steps: Put the onion, carrots, leeks, mushrooms and garlic into the slow cooker.
Lay the chicken thighs on top. Mix the stock with the mustard and thyme, pour it over and season.
Cover and cook on low for 6–7 hours (or high for 3–4), until the chicken is tender and falling apart.
About 20 minutes before serving, stir in the cornflour mix and shred the chicken into the sauce. Put the lid back on to thicken.
Just before serving, stir through the crème fraîche and heat for 5 minutes. Don't let it boil hard or it can split.
Serve with mash or crusty bread.
recipe.tip: On by 8–9am before you head out. Mathilda: mash her portion with a fork and check for bones. Leftovers freeze fine once fully cooled, portioned and labelled for the meal drawer.

2026-10-25.meal: Big cheesy veggie pasta bake (double batch)
2026-10-25.note: Free day, so a double batch: one dish tonight, one in the fridge for Tuesday after Hull hockey training

steps: Soften the onions, courgettes and peppers in the oil in a big pan for 10 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the chopped tomatoes, passata, purée and herbs. Season and simmer for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile cook the penne for 2 minutes less than the pack says (about 9 minutes), then drain.
Mix the pasta into the sauce and take out Mathilda's portion if she wants it plainer.
Split between two ovenproof dishes. Top tonight's with half the cheese and bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 20–25 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Let the second dish cool within an hour, then cover and keep it in the fridge for Tuesday (keep the rest of the cheese back for it).
recipe.tip: Mathilda: if she's not keen on chunky veg, blitz a ladle of her sauce smooth before mixing in her pasta.

2026-10-26.meal: Air-fryer veggie sausages with crispy potato wedges & beans
2026-10-26.note: Swapped from Friday. Half term starts today, evening's free

ingredients: 1/2 tsp smoked paprika (for the grown-ups' wedges)
steps: Toss the potato wedges in the oil, season, and air fry at 200°C for 12 minutes.
Add the paprika to the wedges for the grown-ups now, keeping Mathilda and Francis's plain.
Add the veggie sausages to the air fryer basket alongside the wedges and cook for a further 8-10 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and the wedges are crisp.
Heat the beans in a small pan or the microwave for 3-4 minutes.
Serve the sausages and wedges with the beans.
recipe.tip: Mathilda: cut her sausage into coins and keep her wedges plain.

2026-10-27.meal: Reheat: Sunday's cheesy veggie pasta bake
2026-10-27.note: Hull hockey training 6-7pm (Hymers College) plus travel. Tea ready for whoever's not driving, kept warm for the rest

ingredients: Sunday's second pasta bake (from the fridge)
The rest of the grated cheddar (about 100g)
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan).
Cover the dish with foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Take off the foil, scatter over the cheese and bake for another 10 minutes, until golden and piping hot all the way through.
Serve with salad if anyone wants it.
recipe.tip: Only reheat it once, and check the middle is piping hot. Anyone back late from training can have theirs microwaved separately for 2–3 minutes.

2026-10-28.meal: Baked cod with lemon & herb crumb, new potatoes & green beans
2026-10-28.note: Hockey Academy Night 6:15-7:45pm (The Lindum) — air fryer gets tea done fast either side of the run

ingredients: Small handful fresh parsley, chopped (or 1 tsp dried)
steps: Boil the new potatoes for 15 minutes until tender.
Mix the breadcrumbs, lemon zest, parsley, melted butter and a pinch of salt.
Put the cod fillets in the air fryer basket and press the crumb on top.
Air fry at 180°C for 10-12 minutes, until the crumb is golden and the fish flakes.
Cook the beans for the last 4 minutes of the potatoes. Serve with lemon wedges.
recipe.tip: Mathilda: leave the lemon zest off her portion and check carefully for bones.

2026-10-29.meal: Jacket potatoes, tuna mayo or cheese & beans
2026-10-29.note: Mathilda's hospital eye test is at 2:20pm (dilating drops — she may be unsettled after) — keeping tea simple and familiar tonight

steps: Prick the potatoes all over and microwave on high for 10 minutes to soften.
Transfer to the air fryer at 200°C for 20-25 minutes, until the skins are crisp. (Or straight in the oven at 200°C/180°C fan for 60-75 minutes if you'd rather skip the microwave.)
Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise.
Heat the beans in a pan or the microwave for 3-4 minutes.
Split the potatoes open and top with tuna mayo, cheese or beans.
Serve with salad leaves if anyone wants them.
recipe.tip: Mathilda: she may be sensitive to light and a bit out of sorts after today's eye drops — give her cheese and beans rather than tuna if she's not keen, and keep the lights low for tea.
